surfaces.architecture: Three surfaces, deliberately separate jobs. The CLI executes and verifies the book. The SDK returns chains with greeks in one call. MCP supplies read-only research. Execution never routes through MCP: it is a stdio subprocess, and a hung subprocess must never sit between the agent and its stops.
